name: Creamy Pumpkin-Parmesan Chicken with Spinach & Crispy Sage

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, wash, dry, and pick sage leaves off the stems; discard stems.

Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add sage leaves in single layer and cook until crispy, about 30 seconds. Using tongs or a slotted spoon, transfer crispy sage to a paper towel-lined plate and season with salt. (Reserve pot with oil for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Pat the chicken dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season both sides with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg chicken breasts, boneless skinless
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Return pot to medium-high heat. Once the pot is hot, working in batches if necessary, add chicken and pan-fry, without turning, until golden underneath, 5-6 minutes (the chicken will not be cooked all the way through). Remove to a plate. (Reserve pot with sage oil for later use.)
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, peel and mince garlic.
Return pot with sage oil to medium heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic and tomato paste; cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 tbsp tomato paste

instructions.primary_message: Add Parmesan, pumpkin, broth, cream, and salt to the pot, then stir to combine. Cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce thickens slightly, 3-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (398 ml) cans pure pumpkin purée
355 ml chicken or vegetable broth
355 ml heavy whipping cream
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, and add spinach to the pot in handfuls, waiting for it to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.
Return chicken to the pot and nestle into the sauce; cover with a lid. Cook, turning chicken occasionally, until cooked through, 7-8 minutes. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide chicken and sauce between plates or bowls. Top with crispy sage and enjoy!
